hero.label: Notes from the in-between
hero.heading: Technology keeps changing. The difficult part rarely does.
hero.body: Thinking about systems, judgment, people. And the greatest question: what we must not delegate as we enter AI age?

belief.label: I Believe
statements: AI should be used, not surrendered to.
Complexity deserves nuance. Decisions require clarity.
The technology may be unprecedented. Many of the questions are not.
Information is abundant. Too much. Judgment is not. Never enough.

darkMatter.label: Dark Matter
darkMatter.heading: The work between the work.
narrative: In difficult projects, I have often found myself connecting the pieces that were not supposed to be disconnected in the first place: technology and business, decisions and consequences, formal roles and real responsibility.
I call that dark matter. It is invisible until the system starts to pull apart.
darkMatter.closingThought: The next step is not being indispensable. It is helping other people learn how to see the whole.
darkMatter.supportingText: A good outcome is when I can leave and the system no longer needs me.

running.label: 04 — The Running Project
running.heading: And then I tried to build it.
running.body: I am building a running application almost entirely with AI coding agents. The implementation is often theirs. The concept, constraints, priorities and decisions remain mine.
running.surfaceHeading: The runner remains at the centre.
running.placeholder: Heart-rate intensity shifts from pink towards red. During a long pause, the runner collapses; during a short one, they jog in place. It is playful — but it is also a reminder that a body is not a spreadsheet.
running.supportingStatement: Signal over noise. Flexible plans over false perfection. Assistance without surrender.

arc.label: 05 — A Short Personal Arc
arc.heading: Experience matters only if it doesn’t stop you learning again.
timeline: 1980s — Started programming, because a machine that followed instructions was too interesting to ignore.
Later — Moved through several generations of technology, from small companies to large consulting environments.
Around 50 — Began running marathons; went from a first 3:24 to 2:57 by observing, modelling, experimenting, measuring and adapting.
Now — Building with AI while thinking more carefully about the human work that machines should never replace.

human.label: 06 — Human
human.heading: I am interested in what holds — and what slips through.
human.body: Technology is only one way I pay attention. The rest comes from running, history, philosophy, food, literature, conversation, and a fondness for metaphors that sometimes arrive before the explanation.

personalNarrative.label: 07 — Really About Me
opening: You can't leave a like here.
But perhaps you can leave a little bit of your heart.
Because you are a real human.
personalNarrative.decadeHeading: Every ten years, apparently, I need a new bad idea.

missingMan.heading: Missing Man.
missingMan.body: When I left a long project, I posted the missing-man formation from Goose's funeral. At night. Then I left the chat. I wanted the image to be the first thing they saw the next morning.

artifact.placeholder: Original Missing Man GIF — to be added.

missingMan.reflection: I learned what the missing-man formation meant afterwards. I just knew it was the image I wanted.

pizza.heading: Mortadella pizza needs lemon zest.
lines: The acidity cuts through the fat.
Scratch into the pith and it turns bitter.
Change a small detail, and the meaning of the whole changes.
And no, the internet didn’t tell me to.

wait.heading: WAIT WAIT WAIT
wait.body: I said it often enough that two teammates put it on a T-shirt.

nonnino.label: The nonnino
nonnino.heading: The grandpa runs so fast that when he looks behind him, he sees the avant-garde approaching.

book.label: The book
book.heading: One day I’d like to write a book.
lines: Something that can speak when I’m not there to over-explain it.
Preferably while I’m still around to complain about the reviews.
